data.title: 雪之下雪乃 · 图书馆午后
data.description: 【雪之下雪乃 · 图书馆午后】市立图书馆靠窗的安静角落，金色光尘在书架间的斜阳中缓缓浮动。雪乃倚靠在沉重的老木桌旁，神情专注而清冷。察觉到你的注视，她微微合拢书脊，淡淡地开口——「在图书馆里一直盯着同伴看可不是什么有教养的行为。……不过，这本小说确实很有深度。」
data.location: 市立图书馆窗边长桌旁
data.action: 倚在窗边木桌旁，将小说合拢一半，抬眼看同行者
data.promptProse: At the heavy public-library table, Yukino half closes her novel with one hand and rests the other on the table edge, lifting composed questioning blue eyes toward the viewer. Long black hair and red ribbons flank her tidy navy school uniform. The close-up includes book cover and worn tabletop beneath the high window. Slanting afternoon light catches page edges and her fingers, leaving shallow shadows where the half-closed volume meets the wood.
